description: This file defines a REST controller class for customer management in a banking application, providing endpoints for CRUD operations on customer data.

classes.name: CustomerController
classes.description: REST controller for customer management operations using Spring Web annotations.

methods.name: getAllCustomers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all customers.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new customer.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a customer by customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update customer details.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a customer by customer number.
